descByPlatform.chatgpt: motivational mountain poster for a flagship outdoor brand campaign, 2:3 vertical hero. Subject: a lone climber silhouette cresting a knife-edge snow ridge at sunrise, ice axe in right hand, backpack low, stride mid-step, behind them three layered peaks catch pink-orange alpenglow against deep alpine blue sky, wind-scoured snow plume trailing off the far ridge. Typography: 'RISE' Bebas Neue 140pt bold all-caps in snow white #F5F5F5 centred at 50% x 14% y; quote 'THE MOUNTAIN DOES NOT CARE WHO YOU WERE YESTERDAY' Inter 22pt medium tracking-200 in snow white at 50% x 86% y across two lines. Composition: Rule of Thirds on climber silhouette, Centered 52% x 56% y, subject 12% frame small-against-vast, hero vertical. Camera: 24mm f/8 1/250s ISO 200 wide landscape rig. Lighting: natural sunrise — low hard sun camera-right 8° elevation 180m (key alpenglow), ambient sky fill cool blue bounce, long-cast climber shadow 32° camera-left. Material physics: wind-blown snow crystalline scatter, down jacket fibre halation, ice axe anodised specular, atmospheric haze depth. Palette: alpine blue #1B4965 30%, alpenglow orange #E07A5F 25%, snow white #F5F5F5 25%, slate grey #5C6B73 15%, sun gold #F2CC8F 5%. References: Jimmy Chin, Cory Richards, Patagonia campaign. Exclude: cluttered, low-drama, flat, amateurish, stock.
